name: Minor characters fans have named
summary: Names that fans have attached to people seen or heard in the trailers and screenshots, beyond the characters Rockstar has profiled.
body: Named on the wiki's list: Andrés de León, Aunt Tee, Erin Henshaw, Ernesto, Jack Howitzer, Kenny Brewster, Mendez, Petra Navarro, Phil, Raymond, Rudi, Stefanie, Valentina. It also lists the band Dolls of Destruction and the gangs Final Chapter MC and PTT Youngin$.
The wiki keeps pages for about a dozen people with no known name, such as a corrections officer and an interrogator. Who these characters are and what part they play has not been published.

This is a fan-compiled list from the GTA Wiki, read from trailers and screenshots. Rockstar has not published it, names carried over from earlier games may change, and anything the wiki marks as coming from the 2022 leak is left out.
